description: This file implements the MistralEmbedder class, which wraps an OpenAICompatibleEmbedder to provide embedding functionality using Mistral's API, including configuration validation and error handling.

classes.name: MistralEmbedder
classes.description: A class that provides embedding capabilities via Mistral's API, wrapping an OpenAI-compatible embedder and managing configuration, error handling, and metadata.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new MistralEmbedder with API key and optional model ID, setting up the underlying embedder.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates text embeddings using Mistral's API, with error handling and telemetry logging.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by delegating to the underlying embedder, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the embedder, specifically its name.
